title.zh: 外交与领事关系（国际货币基金组织）命令 2008
title.en: Diplomatic and Consular Relations (International Monetary Fund) Order 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Diplomatic and Consular Relations (International Monetary Fund) Order 2008.

heading.en: Immunities and privileges in addition to those previously conferred

text.en:
3. This Order does not affect —
(a)the Bretton Woods Agreements Order 1966; and
(b)every other written law which sets out the status, immunities and privileges of the Fund, or any of its officers and employees, for the purpose of giving effect to the Articles of Agreement of the Fund.

heading.en: Additional immunities and privileges of Fund in relation to Resident Representative Office

text.en:
4. The Fund enjoys and has in relation to the Resident Representative Office, in addition to its immunities and privileges under the International Organisations (Immunities and Privileges) (International Monetary Fund) Order 2008 —
(a)freedom from censorship for the official communications of the Resident Representative Office;
(b)the right to use codes; and
(c)the right to send and receive correspondence by courier or in a bag, such courier to enjoy the same inviolability as a diplomatic courier, and such bag to have the same status as a diplomatic bag, under Article 27 of the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations.
